topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 20 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 5 ERC4626 vaults, 8 ERC20 tokens, 1 Chainlink feed; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin-upgradeable.
